PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — TERMLY EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Safety in the Immediate Environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Safety in the Immediate Environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Safety in the Immediate Environment.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

4. When learning Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Pre-Technical Studies.

5. When learning Free-hand sketching, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Free-hand sketching.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Free-hand sketching.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Free-hand sketching.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Free-hand sketching.

6. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

7. When learning Introduction to Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Materials.

8. When learning Non- Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Non- Metallic Materials.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Non- Metallic Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Non- Metallic Materials.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Non- Metallic Materials.

9. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools 18 4.2 Computer Hardware 8 5.0 Entrepreneurship .

10. When learning Measuring and Marking Out Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Measuring and Marking Out Tools.

11. When learning ICT Tools in Communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ICT Tools in Communication.
   B. Skip safety briefings for ICT Tools in Communication.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ICT Tools in Communication.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ICT Tools in Communication.

12. When learning Computer Concepts, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Concepts.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Concepts.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Concepts.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Concepts.

13. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

14. When learning Metallic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials.

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Drawing.

16. When learning Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metallic Materials 10 3.3 Non-Metallic Materials 10 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1.
